steps.title: Update the Homebrew package list
steps.explanation: This refreshes the list of available software so Homebrew knows the newest Python version. It does not install anything yet.

steps.title: Upgrade Python 3 to the latest version
steps.explanation: This installs the newest version of Python 3 through Homebrew. Your current Python 3 is replaced with the newer one.

steps.title: Check the new Python version
steps.explanation: This shows which Python 3 version is now active on your Mac. It only reads information.

finish_check.message: Python 3 is up to date with Homebrew
